mapper.insert: INSERT INTO a_a_user (phone,name, status,role,removed, create_time,creator, last_operate_time, last_operator) VALUES (#{phone},#{name}, #{status},#{role},0,#{createTime},#{creator}, #{lastOperateTime}, #{lastOperator})
mapper.select: SELECT phone,name, status,role, removed, create_time,creator, last_operate_time, last_operator FROM a_a_user WHERE phone=#{phone}
SELECT phone,name, status,role,removed, create_time,creator, last_operate_time, last_operator FROM a_a_user WHERE removed=0
SELECT phone,name, status,role,removed, create_time,creator, last_operate_time, last_operator FROM a_a_user WHERE removed=0 AND `role`="ADMIN"
mapper.update: UPDATE a_a_user SET name=#{name}, status=#{status}, role=#{role}, removed=#{removed}, last_operate_time=#{lastOperateTime}, last_operator=#{lastOperator} WHERE phone=#{phone}
